result.question: Compare Apple's services revenue growth rate to its products revenue growth rate over the last two fiscal years.
result.answer:
Based on the available evidence, Apple's services revenue grew significantly faster than its products revenue when comparing FY2023 to FY2024, the two fiscal years for which full products and services breakdowns are provided.

Products revenue declined from $298,085 million in FY2023 to $294,866 million in FY2024, a growth rate of approximately −1.1% [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002].

Services revenue grew from $85,200 million in FY2023 to $96,169 million in FY2024, a growth rate of approximately +12.9% [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. The 10-K confirms that Services net sales increased 13% year-over-year in FY2024, while total Products categories were flat or declining [0000320193-24-000123:item-7-p002].

In summary, services revenue grew at roughly +12.9% year-over-year while products revenue contracted by roughly −1.1%, meaning services growth substantially outpaced products growth in FY2024 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002].

For FY2025, the evidence provides only total net sales of $416,161 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27], compared to FY2024 total net sales of $391,035 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28]. Total net sales grew from $391,035 million in FY2024 to $416,161 million in FY2025, a growth rate of approximately +6.4% [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27]. However, the evidence does not provide a FY2025 breakdown between products and services revenue, so a direct segment-level comparison for FY2025 cannot be made.
